runtime_table_probes.unrecorded_outcome_semantics: These key/table pairs are absent from runtime-tables-index.json. extract_tables.py skips appending an index row when the subprocess succeeds with empty stdout. This inventory labels them UNRECORDED_EMPTY_CANDIDATE; it does not claim an observed empty native result or data absence.

functions_raw_flags.columns: raw row[1..5] after FUNCTION ID; preserved as opaque flags, no semantic labels inferred

join_boundaries: Vehicle id -> car_seriesid and car_platformid are direct fields; all 84 vehicle IDs resolve to one of the 7 recovered series and all referenced platforms occur in the 49 platform/group edges.
car_platformid -> ecu_groupsid -> ecu group row.id is a source-backed integer-key join (the Dart catalog implements this exact relation).

ECU group modulegroup/defaultprotocolid/defaultaddress and probed runtime ECU keys are separate identifier domains. No suffix/name join is emitted here; group-to-runtime-key and group-to-handler attribution remains unresolved unless supported by independently recovered caller/dataflow evidence.
FUNCTIONS row flags remain five uninterpreted source fields; these counts do not imply operation semantics, transport support, write safety, or vehicle compatibility.

count_semantics.vehicle_count: 84 exact vehicle-record rows with 84 unique id values from recovered-native/vehicle-records.json.
count_semantics.ecu_group_count: 29 exact rows with 29 unique id values from recovered-native/ecu-groups.json.
count_semantics.protocol_id_counts: Frequency of raw defaultprotocolid strings on the 29 group rows; no mapping to Dart enum ordinals or protocol names asserted.
count_semantics.table_action: Candidate grid is 68 observed ECU-key strings x 10 table names = 680 candidate pairs. The retained index has 364 result records (234 nonempty outputs plus 130 failures). extract_tables.py skips successful empty stdout; the other 316 pairs are UNRECORDED_EMPTY_CANDIDATE, not observed empty tables or evidence of absence.
count_semantics.row_counts: Sum row_count across successful index actions; row strings verified against per-table payload file and SHA-256.
count_semantics.functions_raw_flags: Frequency of five raw columns immediately after the FUNCTION ID in successful indexed FUNCTIONS rows; no meanings inferred.
count_semantics.unindexed_function_files: Preserved local table JSON files without a matching successful index action; excluded from reported original-probe counts pending provenance reconciliation.
